question: What dual attainment follows from reciting and offering this mantra one hundred thousand times?
premises: One repeats the mantra one hundred thousand times.
The practitioner then attains enjoyment and liberation.
inference: Whoever repeats and offers one hundred thousand times attains both enjoyment and liberation.
uncertainties: dhuned interpreted as fire offering in ritual context.
plain_english: Whoever repeats it one hundred thousand times and makes offerings indeed attains enjoyment and liberation.
